title: Someone Was Here: know who used your Mac
excerpt: A Mac app that takes a photo of anyone who uses your Mac while you're away and sends it to your phone.
content_html:
Your Mac takes a photo of anyone who uses it while you're away, and sends it to your phone.

Free iPhone app included. Instant alerts to your phone are a $4.99 one-time purchase.

Free on the Mac App Store, with a free iPhone app. Instant alerts to your phone are a $4.99 one-time purchase.

When someone sits down, it takes their photo.

Someone uses your Mac after it's been idle, tries the lock screen, or unlocks it. A second later there's a photo of them, with the time, how they got in, and how long they stayed.

When it's you, it stays quiet.

It learns your face in a two-minute setup with a few head turns, and checks every photo right on your Mac. You won't get an alert about yourself.

Then it tells you.

The photo reaches your iPhone within seconds, in the free Someone Was Here app. Nothing changes on screen while they're at your Mac. When it sees you again, your Mac tells you who came by.

It isn't hiding anything.

It sits in your menu bar where you can see it, and it's made for protecting your own Mac. If you share your space, tell people it's there.

The photo arrives in the free Someone Was Here app for iPhone, through your own iCloud. It also works with Pushover, ntfy, Telegram or a webhook.

Find out who it was.

Someone Was Here is free on the Mac App Store. Add the free iPhone app and the photo reaches your phone within seconds.

Then get the free iPhone app on the same page. See the privacy policy.
